source.text: בְּ֭נִי שְׁמֹ֣ר אֲמָרָ֑י וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י תִּצְפֹּ֥ן אִתָּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: My son, keep my sayings, and my commandments treasure up with you.

en.L: My son, keep my sayings, \q and treasure up my commandments with you.
en.B: My son, hold on to what I say, \q and keep my commands safe like treasure.
en.R: My son, remember what I say. \q Value my commands like treasure.

fr.L: Mon fils, garde mes paroles, \q et mes commandements, mets-les en réserve auprès de toi.
fr.B: Mon fils, tiens à ce que je dis, \q et garde mes commandements à l’abri comme un trésor.
fr.R: Mon fils, souviens-toi de ce que je dis. \q Mets mes commandements de côté comme un trésor.

sw.L: Mwanangu, yashike maneno yangu, \q na amri zangu ziweke akiba ndani yako.
sw.B: Mwanangu, shika ninayokuambia, \q na uzihifadhi amri zangu salama kama hazina.
sw.R: Mwanangu, kumbuka ninayokuambia. \q Zithamini amri zangu kama hazina.

es.L: Hijo mío, guarda mis dichos, \q y atesora mis mandamientos contigo.
es.B: Hijo mío, aférrate a lo que te digo, \q y guarda mis mandatos como un tesoro.
es.R: Hijo mío, recuerda lo que te digo. \q Valora mis mandatos como un tesoro.

decisions.choice: keep ... treasure up: as in 2:1
decisions.reason: The chapter opens as chapter 2 did, with the verb for hiding treasure (tsaphan).

source.text: שְׁמֹ֣ר מִצְוֺתַ֣י וֶחְיֵ֑ה וְ֝תוֹרָתִ֗י כְּאִישׁ֥וֹן עֵינֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Keep my commandments and live, and my teaching like [the] pupil of your eyes.

en.L: Keep my commandments and live, \q and my teaching like [the] pupil of your eyes.
en.B: Keep my commands and you will live; \q guard my teaching as carefully as the pupil of your eye.
en.R: Obey my commands, and you will live. \q Protect my teaching the way you protect your eyes.

fr.L: Garde mes commandements et vis, \q et mon enseignement comme la pupille de tes yeux.
fr.B: Garde mes commandements, et tu vivras ; \q veille sur mon enseignement comme sur la prunelle de tes yeux.
fr.R: Obéis à mes commandements, et tu vivras. \q Protège mon enseignement comme tu protèges tes yeux.

sw.L: Shika amri zangu ukaishi, \q na mafundisho yangu kama mboni ya macho yako.
sw.B: Shika amri zangu nawe utaishi; \q yalinde mafundisho yangu kwa uangalifu kama mboni ya jicho lako.
sw.R: Tii amri zangu, nawe utaishi. \q Yalinde mafundisho yangu kama vile unavyoyalinda macho yako.

es.L: Guarda mis mandamientos y vive, \q y mi enseñanza como [la] niña de tus ojos.
es.B: Guarda mis mandatos y vivirás; \q cuida mi enseñanza como cuidas la niña de tus ojos.
es.R: Obedece mis mandatos, y vivirás. \q Protege mi enseñanza como proteges tus ojos.

decisions.choice: the pupil of your eyes: what you protect most carefully
decisions.reason: The word (ishon) means "little man", the tiny reflection seen in another's eye. The eye's pupil is guarded by instinct (Deuteronomy 32:10; Psalm 17:8). The same word is used for the middle of the night in verse 9.

decisions.choice: keep and live: as in 4:4
decisions.reason: The command is also a promise.

source.text: קָשְׁרֵ֥ם עַל־אֶצְבְּעֹתֶ֑יךָ כָּ֝תְבֵ֗ם עַל־ל֥וּחַ לִבֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Bind them on your fingers; write them on [the] tablet of your heart.

en.L: Bind them on your fingers; \q write them on [the] tablet of your heart.
en.B: Tie them around your fingers; \q inscribe them on your heart as on a tablet.
en.R: Keep them close, like a ring on your finger. \q Remember them as if they were written on your heart.

fr.L: Lie-les à tes doigts ; \q écris-les sur la tablette de ton cœur.
fr.B: Attache-les autour de tes doigts ; \q grave-les sur ton cœur comme sur une tablette.
fr.R: Garde-les tout près de toi, comme une bague à ton doigt. \q Souviens-t’en comme s’ils étaient écrits sur ton cœur.

sw.L: Zifunge vidoleni mwako; \q ziandike juu ya kibao cha moyo wako.
sw.B: Zifunge kuzunguka vidole vyako; \q uzichore moyoni mwako kama juu ya kibao.
sw.R: Ziweke karibu nawe, kama pete kidoleni mwako. \q Zikumbuke kana kwamba zimeandikwa moyoni mwako.

es.L: Átalos a tus dedos; \q escríbelos en [la] tabla de tu corazón.
es.B: Átalos alrededor de tus dedos; \q grábalos en tu corazón como en una tabla.
es.R: Tenlos cerca, como un anillo en el dedo. \q Recuérdalos como si estuvieran escritos en tu corazón.

decisions.choice: bind ... write: as in 3:3 and Deuteronomy 6:8
decisions.reason: The fingers may suggest a ring or a reminder tied to the hand, always in sight.

source.text: אֱמֹ֣ר לַֽ֭חָכְמָה אֲחֹ֣תִי אָ֑תְּ וּ֝מֹדָ֗ע לַבִּינָ֥ה תִקְרָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: Say to wisdom, My sister [are] you, and kinsman to understanding you will call,

en.L: Say to wisdom, "You [are] my sister," \q and call understanding [your] close relative,
en.B: Tell wisdom, "You are my sister," \q and give understanding the name of dearest friend,
en.R: Love wisdom like a member of your family. \q Make understanding your closest friend.

fr.L: Dis à la sagesse : « Tu [es] ma sœur », \q et appelle l’intelligence [ta] parente,
fr.B: Dis à la sagesse : « Tu es ma sœur », \q et donne à l’intelligence le nom d’amie très chère,
fr.R: Aime la sagesse comme quelqu’un de ta famille. \q Fais de l’intelligence ta meilleure amie.

sw.L: Iambie hekima, "Wewe [ni] dada yangu," \q na ufahamu uuite ndugu [yako] wa karibu,
sw.B: Iambie hekima, "Wewe ni dada yangu," \q na ufahamu uupe jina la rafiki mpendwa,
sw.R: Ipende hekima kama mtu wa jamaa yako. \q Ufanye ufahamu kuwa rafiki yako wa karibu kabisa.

es.L: Di a la sabiduría: «Tú [eres] mi hermana», \q y llama al entendimiento [tu] pariente cercano,
es.B: Dile a la sabiduría: «Tú eres mi hermana», \q y llama al entendimiento tu amigo más querido,
es.R: Ama a la sabiduría como a alguien de tu familia. \q Haz del entendimiento tu mejor amigo.

decisions.choice: my sister: a word of love for a bride
decisions.reason: In the Song of Songs the bridegroom calls his bride "my sister" (Song of Songs 4:9–10). The son is to love Wisdom as his own, so that the strange woman has no place.

decisions.choice: close relative: kin, intimate friend
decisions.reason: The word (moda) means a kinsman (Ruth 2:1, in a related form), someone one belongs to.

source.text: לִ֭שְׁמָרְךָ מֵאִשָּׁ֣ה זָרָ֑ה מִ֝נָּכְרִיָּ֗ה אֲמָרֶ֥יהָ הֶחֱלִֽיקָה׃

records.literal_gloss: to keep you from a strange woman, from a foreign [woman] [who] makes smooth her sayings.

en.L: to keep you from [the] strange woman, \q from [the] foreign [woman who] makes her sayings smooth.
en.B: so that they keep you from the woman who is not yours, \q the outsider with her flattering words.
en.R: They will keep you away from a woman who belongs to another man \q and from her sweet talk.

fr.L: pour te garder de la femme étrangère, \q de l’inconnue [qui] rend ses paroles doucereuses.
fr.B: pour qu’elles te gardent de la femme étrangère, qui n’est pas pour toi, \q de l’inconnue aux paroles flatteuses.
fr.R: Elles te garderont loin de la femme d’un autre \q et de ses belles paroles.

sw.L: ili zikulinde na mwanamke mgeni, \q na [mwanamke] wa kigeni [aliye]yalainisha maneno yake.
sw.B: ili zikulinde na mwanamke mgeni, asiye halali yako, \q yule mgeni mwenye maneno ya kubembeleza.
sw.R: Zitakuweka mbali na mke wa mtu mwingine \q na maneno yake matamu.

es.L: para guardarte de [la] mujer ajena, \q de [la] extranjera [que] suaviza sus dichos.
es.B: para que te guarden de la mujer ajena, \q de la extranjera con sus palabras aduladoras.
es.R: Te mantendrán lejos de la mujer de otro hombre \q y de sus palabras dulces.

decisions.choice: the strange and foreign woman: the words of 2:16
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 2:16 almost exactly and introduces the story that follows.

source.text: כִּ֭י בְּחַלּ֣וֹן בֵּיתִ֑י בְּעַ֖ד אֶשְׁנַבִּ֣י נִשְׁקָֽפְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: For at [the] window of my house, through my lattice I looked down,

en.L: For at [the] window of my house, \q through my lattice I looked down,
en.B: Once, from the window of my house, \q I looked down through the lattice,
en.R: Once I was looking out through the window of my house.

fr.L: Car à la fenêtre de ma maison, \q à travers mon treillis, j’ai regardé,
fr.B: Un jour, de la fenêtre de ma maison, \q j’ai regardé au travers du treillis,
fr.R: Un jour, je regardais par la fenêtre de ma maison.

sw.L: Kwa maana kwenye dirisha la nyumba yangu, \q kupitia kimia changu nilichungulia chini,
sw.B: Siku moja, kutoka dirishani mwa nyumba yangu, \q nilichungulia chini kupitia kimia,
sw.R: Siku moja nilikuwa nikichungulia nje kupitia dirisha la nyumba yangu.

es.L: Porque desde [la] ventana de mi casa, \q a través de mi celosía miré,
es.B: Una vez, desde la ventana de mi casa, \q miré hacia abajo a través de la celosía,
es.R: Una vez estaba mirando por la ventana de mi casa.

decisions.choice: I looked down, as the Hebrew text has it
alternatives: she looks out (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: In the Hebrew the father watches from his window. The ancient Greek translation has the woman looking out of her window for a young man.

decisions.choice: lattice: a wooden screen over a window
decisions.reason: Windows had latticework instead of glass (Judges 5:28). One could see out without being seen.

decisions.choice: the father's story (verses 6–23) in the tenses of speech: passé composé and imperfect, with the present where the English Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew's vivid present (verses 10–13)
alternatives: the passé simple of written narrative
decisions.reason: The father tells his son what he once saw, so the story is speech, and French speech tells the past with the passé composé, as the French style guide sets for stories told inside speech.

decisions.choice: "kimia" for the lattice
decisions.reason: "Kimia" is the wooden screen over a window in coastal Swahili houses, the same kind of screen the Hebrew means; Readable leaves it out.

source.text: וָאֵ֤רֶא בַפְּתָאיִ֗ם אָ֘בִ֤ינָה בַבָּנִ֗ים נַ֣עַר חֲסַר־לֵֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: and I saw among the simple; I noticed among the sons a youth lacking heart,

en.L: and I saw among the simple, \q I noticed among the sons, \q a young man lacking heart,
en.B: and among the naive I saw, \q among the young men I noticed, \q a youth with no sense,
en.R: I saw a group of young men who did not know much about life. \q One of them had no sense at all.

fr.L: et j’ai vu parmi les simples, \q j’ai remarqué parmi les fils, \q un jeune homme qui manquait de cœur,
fr.B: et parmi les naïfs j’ai vu, \q parmi les jeunes gens j’ai remarqué, \q un garçon dépourvu de bon sens,
fr.R: J’ai vu un groupe de jeunes gens qui ne savaient pas grand-chose de la vie. \q L’un d’eux n’avait aucun bon sens.

sw.L: nikaona miongoni mwa wajinga, \q nikatambua miongoni mwa wana, \q kijana aliyepungukiwa na moyo,
sw.B: nikaona miongoni mwa wajinga, \q nikamtambua miongoni mwa vijana, \q kijana mmoja asiye na akili,
sw.R: Niliona kundi la vijana wasiojua mengi kuhusu maisha. \q Mmoja wao hakuwa na akili hata kidogo.

es.L: y vi entre los simples, \q noté entre los hijos, \q a un joven falto de corazón,
es.B: y entre los ingenuos vi, \q entre los muchachos noté, \q a un joven sin sentido común,
es.R: Vi a un grupo de muchachos que no sabían mucho de la vida. \q Uno de ellos no tenía nada de sentido común.

decisions.choice: the simple: the naive of 1:4
decisions.reason: The young man is one of the simple (petayim), the people chapter 1 was written for (1:4, 22).

decisions.choice: lacking heart: without sense
decisions.reason: As in 6:32.

source.text: עֹבֵ֣ר בַּ֭שּׁוּק אֵ֣צֶל פִּנָּ֑הּ וְדֶ֖רֶךְ בֵּיתָ֣הּ יִצְעָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: passing in the street beside her corner, and [the] way of her house he strode,

en.L: passing along the street beside her corner, \q and he strode [on the] way to her house,
en.B: walking down the street near her corner, \q stepping out along the road to her house,
en.R: He was walking down the street near the corner where she lived, \q toward her house.

fr.L: qui passait dans la rue près de son coin, \q et il marchait à grands pas [sur] le chemin de sa maison,
fr.B: il descendait la rue près du coin où elle habitait \q et s’avançait sur la route de sa maison,
fr.R: Il marchait dans la rue, près du coin où elle habitait, \q en direction de sa maison.

sw.L: akipita barabarani karibu na pembe yake, \q naye akaenda kwa hatua [kwenye] njia ya nyumba yake,
sw.B: akitembea barabarani karibu na pembe ya mtaa wake, \q akipiga hatua katika njia iendayo nyumbani kwake,
sw.R: Alikuwa akitembea barabarani karibu na pembe alipoishi mwanamke mmoja, \q akielekea nyumbani kwake.

es.L: que pasaba por la calle junto a su esquina, \q y [por el] camino de su casa iba,
es.B: que caminaba por la calle cerca de la esquina de ella, \q avanzando por el camino que lleva a su casa,
es.R: Iba caminando por la calle cerca de la esquina donde ella vivía, \q hacia su casa.

decisions.choice: passing ... strode: drifting toward trouble
decisions.reason: He is not said to be looking for her, but he walks the road that leads to her house (5:8).

source.text: בְּנֶֽשֶׁף־בְּעֶ֥רֶב י֑וֹם בְּאִישׁ֥וֹן לַ֝֗יְלָה וַאֲפֵלָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: in [the] twilight, in [the] evening of [the] day, in [the] pupil of [the] night and darkness.

en.L: in [the] twilight, in [the] evening of [the] day, \q in [the] middle of [the] night and darkness.
en.B: at dusk, as the day turned to evening, \q as the black of night came on.
en.R: It was getting dark. \q Evening was turning into night.

fr.L: au crépuscule, au soir du jour, \q au cœur de la nuit et de l’obscurité.
fr.B: à la tombée du jour, quand venait le soir, \q quand arrivait le noir de la nuit.
fr.R: Il commençait à faire sombre. \q Le soir faisait place à la nuit.

sw.L: wakati wa magharibi, jioni ya mchana, \q katikati ya usiku na giza.
sw.B: wakati wa magharibi, mchana ulipogeuka kuwa jioni, \q giza nene la usiku lilipoingia.
sw.R: Giza lilikuwa likiingia. \q Jioni ilikuwa ikigeuka kuwa usiku.

es.L: en [el] crepúsculo, en [la] tarde del día, \q en [lo] negro de [la] noche y de la oscuridad.
es.B: al anochecer, cuando el día se volvía tarde, \q cuando llegaba lo negro de la noche.
es.R: Estaba oscureciendo. \q La tarde se convertía en noche.

decisions.choice: twilight ... night and darkness: time passing
decisions.reason: The line moves from dusk to full darkness, as if the father watched for a long time. The word for "middle" is the "pupil" of verse 2: the black center of the night.

source.text: וְהִנֵּ֣ה אִ֭שָּׁה לִקְרָאת֑וֹ שִׁ֥ית ז֝וֹנָ֗ה וּנְצֻ֥רַת לֵֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And look, a woman to meet him, [in the] garment of a prostitute and guarded of heart.

en.L: And look, a woman [came] to meet him, \q [in the] garment of a prostitute and guarded of heart.
en.B: Then out came a woman to meet him, \q dressed as a prostitute, her mind full of schemes.
en.R: Just then a woman stepped out toward him. \q She was dressed like a prostitute, and she was planning to trick him.

fr.L: Et voici, une femme [vient] à sa rencontre, \q [dans une] tenue de prostituée et le cœur dissimulé.
fr.B: Et voici qu’une femme sort à sa rencontre, \q habillée en prostituée, l’esprit plein de ruses.
fr.R: Juste à ce moment, une femme s’est avancée vers lui. \q Elle était habillée comme une prostituée, et elle avait l’intention de le piéger.

sw.L: Na tazama, mwanamke [akaja] kumlaki, \q [akiwa amevaa] vazi la kahaba, na mwenye moyo wa hila.
sw.B: Ndipo mwanamke akatoka kumlaki, \q amevaa kama kahaba, na moyo wake umejaa hila.
sw.R: Mara mwanamke mmoja akatoka akamwendea. \q Alikuwa amevaa kama kahaba, naye alikuwa akipanga kumdanganya.

es.L: Y he aquí, una mujer [salió] a su encuentro, \q [con] vestido de prostituta y astuta de corazón.
es.B: Entonces salió una mujer a su encuentro, \q vestida como una prostituta, con la mente llena de artimañas.
es.R: En ese momento una mujer salió hacia él. \q Estaba vestida como una prostituta y planeaba engañarlo.

decisions.choice: guarded of heart: keeping her real purpose hidden
alternatives: with a heart set on her goal
decisions.reason: Her heart is "guarded" (natsur): she shows nothing of what she intends. The son was told to guard his heart (4:23); she guards hers to deceive.

decisions.choice: the garment of a prostitute: dressed like one
decisions.reason: She is a married woman (verse 19), but she dresses like a prostitute (Genesis 38:14–15).

source.text: הֹמִיָּ֣ה הִ֣יא וְסֹרָ֑רֶת בְּ֝בֵיתָ֗הּ לֹא־יִשְׁכְּנ֥וּ רַגְלֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Boisterous [is] she and rebellious; in her house her feet do not stay.

en.L: She [is] loud and defiant; \q in her house her feet do not stay.
en.B: She is loud and unruly; \q her feet never stay at home.
en.R: She is loud and does whatever she wants. \q She never stays at home.

fr.L: Elle [est] bruyante et rebelle ; \q dans sa maison ses pieds ne restent pas.
fr.B: Elle est bruyante et indocile ; \q ses pieds ne restent jamais à la maison.
fr.R: Elle est bruyante et elle fait tout ce qu’elle veut. \q Elle ne reste jamais chez elle.

sw.L: Yeye [ni] mwenye kelele na mkaidi; \q miguu yake haikai nyumbani mwake.
sw.B: Yeye ni mwenye kelele na asiyetawalika; \q miguu yake haikai nyumbani kamwe.
sw.R: Ni mwenye kelele, naye hufanya lolote analotaka. \q Hakai nyumbani kamwe.

es.L: Ella [es] alborotadora y rebelde; \q en su casa no se quedan sus pies.
es.B: Es escandalosa e indomable; \q sus pies nunca se quedan en casa.
es.R: Es escandalosa y hace lo que le da la gana. \q Nunca se queda en casa.

decisions.choice: loud and defiant
decisions.reason: The first word (homiyyah) is used of Folly herself in 9:13; the second (sorer) of a stubborn, rebellious son (Deuteronomy 21:18).

decisions.choice: verses 11–12: an aside about her habits
decisions.reason: The father pauses the story to describe how she lives, then picks it up again in verse 13.

source.text: פַּ֤עַם׀בַּח֗וּץ פַּ֥עַם בָּרְחֹב֑וֹת וְאֵ֖צֶל כָּל־פִּנָּ֣ה תֶאֱרֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: A time in the street, a time in the squares, and beside every corner she lies in wait.

en.L: A time in the street, a time in the squares, \q and beside every corner she lies in wait.
en.B: One moment she is out in the street, \q the next in the squares, \q waiting in ambush at every corner.
en.R: Sometimes she is in the street and sometimes in the town square. \q She waits at every corner to catch someone.

fr.L: Tantôt dans la rue, tantôt sur les places, \q et près de chaque coin elle est aux aguets.
fr.B: Un moment elle est dehors dans la rue, \q l’instant d’après sur les places, \q elle guette à chaque coin.
fr.R: Parfois elle est dans la rue, parfois sur la place. \q Elle attend à chaque coin pour attraper quelqu’un.

sw.L: Mara barabarani, mara viwanjani, \q na karibu na kila pembe huvizia.
sw.B: Mara yuko nje barabarani, \q mara katika viwanja, \q akivizia katika kila pembe.
sw.R: Wakati mwingine yuko barabarani, na wakati mwingine katika uwanja wa mji. \q Husubiri katika kila pembe ili amnase mtu.

es.L: Una vez en la calle, otra vez en las plazas, \q y junto a cada esquina acecha.
es.B: Un momento está fuera, en la calle, \q al siguiente en las plazas, \q acechando en cada esquina.
es.R: A veces está en la calle y a veces en la plaza. \q Espera en cada esquina para atrapar a alguien.

decisions.choice: street ... squares ... lies in wait
decisions.reason: She goes where Wisdom calls (1:20–21), but she lies in wait like the gang of 1:11.

source.text: וְהֶחֱזִ֣יקָהבּ֭וֹוְנָ֣שְׁקָה־לּ֑וֹ הֵעֵ֥זָה פָ֝נֶ֗יהָ וַתֹּ֣אמַר לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And she takes hold on him and kisses him; she makes strong her face and says to him,

en.L: And she seizes him and kisses him; \q she makes her face bold and says to him,
en.B: She grabs him and kisses him, \q and with a brazen face she tells him,
en.R: She grabbed him and kissed him. \q Without any shame, she said to him,

fr.L: Et elle le saisit et l’embrasse ; \q elle durcit son visage et lui dit :
fr.B: Elle l’attrape et l’embrasse, \q et avec un visage effronté elle lui dit :
fr.R: Elle l’a attrapé et l’a embrassé. \q Sans aucune honte, elle lui a dit :

sw.L: Naye akamshika na kumbusu; \q akaukaza uso wake akamwambia,
sw.B: Akamkamata na kumbusu, \q na kwa uso usio na haya akamwambia,
sw.R: Alimkamata akambusu. \q Bila haya yoyote, akamwambia,

es.L: Y lo agarra y lo besa; \q endurece su rostro y le dice:
es.B: Lo agarra y lo besa, \q y con cara descarada le dice:
es.R: Lo agarró y lo besó. \q Sin ninguna vergüenza, le dijo:

decisions.choice: makes her face strong: shows no shame
decisions.reason: A "strong" face is a hard, unblushing one (21:29).

source.text: זִבְחֵ֣י שְׁלָמִ֣ים עָלָ֑י הַ֝יּ֗וֹם שִׁלַּ֥מְתִּי נְדָרָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Sacrifices of peace offerings [are] on me; today I have paid my vows.

en.L: "Sacrifices of peace offerings [are] on me; \q today I have paid my vows.
en.B: "I had peace offerings to make, \q and today I have kept my vows.
en.R: "I went to the temple today and gave my offerings to keep my promises to God. \q I have meat from the sacrifice at home.

fr.L: « Des sacrifices de communion [sont] sur moi ; \q aujourd’hui j’ai accompli mes vœux.
fr.B: « J’avais des sacrifices de communion à offrir, \q et aujourd’hui j’ai accompli mes vœux.
fr.R: « Je suis allée au temple aujourd’hui pour offrir mes sacrifices et tenir mes promesses à Dieu. \q J’ai à la maison de la viande du sacrifice.

sw.L: "Sadaka za amani [ziko] juu yangu; \q leo nimetimiza nadhiri zangu.
sw.B: "Nilikuwa na sadaka za amani za kutoa, \q na leo nimetimiza nadhiri zangu.
sw.R: "Leo nilikwenda hekaluni nikatoa sadaka zangu ili kutimiza ahadi zangu kwa Mungu. \q Nina nyama ya sadaka nyumbani.

es.L: «Sacrificios de paz [hay] sobre mí; \q hoy he cumplido mis votos.
es.B: «Tenía que ofrecer sacrificios de paz, \q y hoy he cumplido mis votos.
es.R: «Hoy fui al templo y presenté mis ofrendas para cumplir mis promesas a Dios. \q Tengo en casa carne del sacrificio.

decisions.choice: peace offerings ... vows: she has meat at home
decisions.reason: A peace offering paid for a vow was shared: part was burned, and the worshiper ate the rest the same day or the next (Leviticus 7:15–16). She has a feast waiting and a show of religion to cover her.

decisions.choice: I have meat from the sacrifice at home
alternatives: Sacrifices of peace offerings are on me
decisions.reason: Readable says what her words imply (m1), which a young reader would not know.

decisions.choice: "sacrifices de communion" for the peace offerings (shelamim)
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch terms set this offering for French; the worshipper took most of its meat home to eat, which is the point here (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: sacrificios de paz
decisions.reason: The offering (shelamim) is "el sacrificio de paz", as in the Spanish of the Pentateuch; the worshiper took home much of its meat, which is the point of her words. Readable says so, as the English Readable does.

source.text: עַל־כֵּ֭ן יָצָ֣אתִי לִקְרָאתֶ֑ךָ לְשַׁחֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וָאֶמְצָאֶֽךָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore I have come out to meet you, to seek your face, and I have found you.

en.L: Therefore I have come out to meet you, \q to seek your face eagerly, and I have found you.
en.B: That is why I came out looking for you; \q I was eager to see you, and here you are!
en.R: So I came out to find you. \q I wanted to see you, and now I have found you!

fr.L: C’est pourquoi je suis sortie à ta rencontre, \q pour chercher ta face avec ardeur, et je t’ai trouvé.
fr.B: Voilà pourquoi je suis sortie te chercher ; \q j’avais hâte de te voir, et te voici !
fr.R: Alors je suis sortie pour te trouver. \q Je voulais te voir, et maintenant je t’ai trouvé !

sw.L: Kwa hiyo nimetoka kukulaki, \q kuutafuta uso wako kwa bidii, nami nimekuona.
sw.B: Ndiyo sababu nimetoka kukutafuta; \q nilitamani sana kukuona, na tazama, uko hapa!
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nimetoka kukutafuta. \q Nilitaka kukuona, na sasa nimekupata!

es.L: Por eso he salido a tu encuentro, \q a buscar con afán tu rostro, y te he hallado.
es.B: Por eso salí a buscarte; \q tenía ganas de verte, ¡y aquí estás!
es.R: Así que salí a buscarte. \q Quería verte, ¡y ya te encontré!

decisions.choice: seek eagerly: search hard
decisions.reason: The verb (shahar) used of those who seek Wisdom in 1:28 and 8:17. She claims to have sought him as Wisdom is to be sought.

source.text: מַ֭רְבַדִּים רָבַ֣דְתִּי עַרְשִׂ֑י חֲ֝טֻב֗וֹת אֵט֥וּן מִצְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: [With] coverings I have spread my couch, colored fabrics of linen of Egypt.

en.L: [With] coverings I have spread my couch, \q colored fabrics of Egyptian linen.
en.B: I have spread my couch with covers, \q with colored sheets of Egyptian linen.
en.R: I have made my bed with soft covers \q and beautiful sheets from Egypt.

fr.L: [De] couvertures j’ai garni mon divan, \q d’étoffes colorées de lin d’Égypte.
fr.B: J’ai garni mon divan de couvertures, \q de draps colorés en lin d’Égypte.
fr.R: J’ai fait mon lit avec des couvertures douces \q et de beaux draps venus d’Égypte.

sw.L: [Kwa] matandiko nimetandika kitanda changu, \q vitambaa vya rangi vya kitani ya Misri.
sw.B: Nimetandika kitanda changu kwa matandiko, \q kwa shuka za rangi za kitani ya Misri.
sw.R: Nimetandika kitanda changu kwa matandiko laini \q na shuka nzuri kutoka Misri.

es.L: [Con] colchas he cubierto mi diván, \q telas de colores de lino de Egipto.
es.B: He cubierto mi diván con colchas, \q con sábanas de colores de lino egipcio.
es.R: He preparado mi cama con mantas suaves \q y sábanas hermosas de Egipto.

decisions.choice: Egyptian linen: an expensive import
decisions.reason: Fine linen from Egypt was a luxury (Ezekiel 27:7). The wife of 31:22 makes her own coverings.

source.text: נַ֥פְתִּי מִשְׁכָּבִ֑י מֹ֥ר אֲ֝הָלִ֗ים וְקִנָּמֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: I have sprinkled my bed [with] myrrh, aloes and cinnamon.

en.L: I have sprinkled my bed [with] myrrh, \q aloes and cinnamon.
en.B: I have scented my bed with myrrh, \q aloes and cinnamon.
en.R: I have made my bed smell sweet with perfume.

fr.L: J’ai aspergé ma couche [de] myrrhe, \q d’aloès et de cinnamome.
fr.B: J’ai parfumé mon lit de myrrhe, \q d’aloès et de cannelle.
fr.R: J’ai mis du parfum sur mon lit pour qu’il sente bon.

sw.L: Nimenyunyiza kitanda changu [kwa] manemane, \q udi na mdalasini.
sw.B: Nimekitia kitanda changu harufu ya manemane, \q udi na mdalasini.
sw.R: Nimekifanya kitanda changu kinukie manukato matamu.

es.L: He rociado mi lecho [con] mirra, \q áloe y canela.
es.B: He perfumado mi cama con mirra, \q áloe y canela.
es.R: He perfumado mi cama para que huela bien.

decisions.choice: myrrh, aloes and cinnamon: costly perfumes
decisions.reason: The same spices perfume the lovers of the Song of Songs (4:14) and the king's robes (Psalm 45:9).

source.text: לְכָ֤ה נִרְוֶ֣ה דֹ֭דִים עַד־הַבֹּ֑קֶר נִ֝תְעַלְּסָ֗ה בָּאֳהָבִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Come, let us drink our fill of love until the morning; let us delight ourselves with loves.

en.L: Come, let us drink our fill of love until the morning; \q let us delight ourselves with lovemaking.
en.B: Come, let us drink deep of love until morning \q and take our pleasure in lovemaking.
en.R: Come with me! We can make love all night long.

fr.L: Viens, enivrons-nous d’amour jusqu’au matin ; \q délectons-nous de caresses.
fr.B: Viens, buvons l’amour à longs traits jusqu’au matin \q et prenons plaisir à faire l’amour.
fr.R: Viens avec moi ! Nous pouvons faire l’amour toute la nuit.

sw.L: Njoo, tunywe mapenzi mpaka kushiba hadi asubuhi; \q tujifurahishe kwa mahaba.
sw.B: Njoo, tunywe mapenzi kwa wingi mpaka asubuhi, \q tujifurahishe kwa mahaba.
sw.R: Njoo nami! Tunaweza kufanya mapenzi usiku kucha.

es.L: Ven, embriaguémonos de amores hasta la mañana; \q deleitémonos con caricias.
es.B: Ven, bebamos a fondo del amor hasta la mañana \q y gocemos haciendo el amor.
es.R: ¡Ven conmigo! Podemos hacer el amor toda la noche.

decisions.choice: love ... lovemaking: physical love
decisions.reason: The words (dodim, ohabim) are words for lovemaking (Song of Songs 1:2; 5:1).

decisions.choice: drink our fill: the water of 5:15–19
decisions.reason: The father told the son to drink from his own well and be satisfied with his wife's love (5:15, 19). She offers the same words for what is not his.

source.text: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין הָאִ֣ישׁ בְּבֵית֑וֹ הָ֝לַ֗ךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ מֵרָחֽוֹק׃

records.literal_gloss: For the man is not in his house; he has gone on a journey far away.

en.L: For the man [is] not in his house; \q he has gone on a journey far away.
en.B: The man of the house is away; \q he has gone on a long trip.
en.R: My husband is away. \q He is traveling far from here.

fr.L: Car l’homme n’[est] pas dans sa maison ; \q il est parti en voyage au loin.
fr.B: Le maître de la maison est absent ; \q il est parti pour un long voyage.
fr.R: Mon mari n’est pas là. \q Il voyage loin d’ici.

sw.L: Kwa maana mume hayuko nyumbani mwake; \q amekwenda safari ya mbali.
sw.B: Mwenye nyumba hayupo; \q amekwenda safari ndefu.
sw.R: Mume wangu hayupo. \q Amesafiri mbali na hapa.

es.L: Porque el hombre no [está] en su casa; \q se ha ido de viaje lejos.
es.B: El dueño de casa no está; \q se ha ido de viaje largo.
es.R: Mi esposo no está. \q Está de viaje, muy lejos de aquí.

decisions.choice: the man: her husband
decisions.reason: She does not say "my husband" but "the man", as if he were nothing to her.

decisions.choice: my husband
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly who he is.

source.text: צְֽרוֹר־הַ֭כֶּסֶף לָקַ֣ח בְּיָד֑וֹ לְי֥וֹם הַ֝כֵּ֗סֶא יָבֹ֥א בֵיתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: The bag of the money he has taken in his hand; at [the] day of the full moon he will come home.

en.L: The bag of money he has taken in his hand; \q at [the] day of the full moon he will come [to] his house."
en.B: He took a bag of money with him \q and will not be home until the full moon."
en.R: He took a lot of money with him, \q and he will not be back for a long time."

fr.L: Il a pris la bourse d’argent dans sa main ; \q au jour de la pleine lune il rentrera [dans] sa maison. »
fr.B: Il a emporté une bourse pleine d’argent \q et ne rentrera pas avant la pleine lune. »
fr.R: Il a emporté beaucoup d’argent, \q et il ne reviendra pas avant longtemps. »

sw.L: Mfuko wa fedha ameuchukua mkononi mwake; \q siku ya mwezi mpevu atakuja nyumbani kwake."
sw.B: Alichukua mfuko wa fedha pamoja naye, \q wala hatarudi nyumbani mpaka mwezi mpevu."
sw.R: Alichukua fedha nyingi pamoja naye, \q wala hatarudi kwa muda mrefu."

es.L: La bolsa del dinero ha tomado en su mano; \q el día de la luna llena vendrá a su casa».
es.B: Se llevó una bolsa de dinero \q y no volverá a casa hasta la luna llena».
es.R: Se llevó mucho dinero, \q y no va a volver en mucho tiempo».

decisions.choice: the full moon: about two weeks away
decisions.reason: The word (kese) is the full moon, a time of festival (Psalm 81:4). A bag of money means a long business journey. There is no danger of his coming back.

source.text: הִ֭טַּתּוּ בְּרֹ֣ב לִקְחָ֑הּ בְּחֵ֥לֶק שְׂ֝פָתֶ֗יהָ תַּדִּיחֶֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: She turns him with [the] greatness of her persuasion; with [the] smoothness of her lips she impels him.

en.L: She turns him aside with the greatness of her persuasion; \q with the smoothness of her lips she drives him.
en.B: With all her powers of persuasion she wins him over; \q with her smooth talk she pushes him on.
en.R: Her sweet, clever words make him give in. \q Her smooth talk pulls him along.

fr.L: Elle le détourne par la grandeur de sa persuasion ; \q par la douceur de ses lèvres elle l’entraîne.
fr.B: Par toute sa force de persuasion elle le gagne ; \q par ses paroles doucereuses elle le pousse.
fr.R: Ses paroles douces et habiles le font céder. \q Ses belles paroles l’entraînent.

sw.L: Humgeuza kwa wingi wa ushawishi wake; \q kwa ulaini wa midomo yake humsukuma.
sw.B: Kwa ustadi wake wote wa kushawishi anamshinda; \q kwa maneno yake laini anamsukuma aendelee.
sw.R: Maneno yake matamu ya ujanja yanamfanya akubali. \q Maneno yake laini yanamvuta.

es.L: Lo desvía con la abundancia de su persuasión; \q con la suavidad de sus labios lo arrastra.
es.B: Con todo su poder de persuasión lo convence; \q con sus palabras suaves lo empuja.
es.R: Sus palabras dulces y astutas lo hacen ceder. \q Su conversación suave lo arrastra.

decisions.choice: persuasion: the word for "learning"
decisions.reason: The word (leqah) is the "learning" the wise gain in 1:5 and 4:2. She has her own teaching, and he receives it.

decisions.choice: drives: pushes on, compels
decisions.reason: The verb (nadah) means to push or drive along.

source.text: ה֤וֹלֵ֥ךְ אַחֲרֶ֗יהָ פִּ֫תְאֹ֥ם כְּ֭שׁוֹר אֶל־טָ֣בַחיָב֑וֹא וּ֝כְעֶ֗כֶס אֶל־מוּסַ֥ר אֱוִֽיל׃

records.literal_gloss: He goes after her suddenly like an ox to slaughter goes, and like an anklet to [the] discipline of a fool,

en.L: He goes after her at once, \q like an ox [that] goes to slaughter, \q and like an anklet to [the] discipline of a fool,
en.B: All at once he is following her, \q like an ox on its way to be slaughtered, \q like a fool in fetters on the way to punishment,
en.R: Right away he follows her, like an ox going to be killed. \q He is like a fool being led away in chains to be punished.

fr.L: Il va derrière elle aussitôt, \q comme un bœuf [qui] va à l’abattoir, \q et comme un anneau de cheville vers la discipline de l’insensé,
fr.B: Tout à coup il la suit, \q comme un bœuf qu’on mène à l’abattoir, \q comme un insensé enchaîné qu’on emmène pour le punir,
fr.R: Aussitôt il la suit, comme un bœuf qu’on va tuer. \q Il ressemble à un insensé qu’on emmène enchaîné pour le punir.

sw.L: Anamfuata mara moja, \q kama ng'ombe [aendavyo] machinjoni, \q na kama kikuku kwa nidhamu ya mpumbavu,
sw.B: Ghafla anamfuata, \q kama ng'ombe anayepelekwa kuchinjwa, \q kama mpumbavu aliyefungwa pingu akipelekwa kuadhibiwa,
sw.R: Mara moja anamfuata, kama ng'ombe anayepelekwa kuchinjwa. \q Yeye ni kama mpumbavu anayepelekwa kwa minyororo ili aadhibiwe.

es.L: Él va tras ella al instante, \q como un buey [que] va al matadero, \q y como con grilletes a [la] disciplina del necio,
es.B: De repente va tras ella, \q como un buey camino del matadero, \q como un necio encadenado camino del castigo,
es.R: Enseguida la sigue, como un buey que van a matar. \q Es como un necio al que llevan encadenado para castigarlo.

decisions.choice: like an anklet to the discipline of a fool, as the Hebrew text reads
alternatives: like a stag leaping into a noose (a common correction)
like a dog to the leash (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew line is hard to read: "like an anklet (or fetter) to the discipline of a fool". Many correct a few letters to read "like a stag stepping into a noose", which fits the arrow and the bird of verse 23. The ancient versions differ. The sense is clear: he is walking into a trap.

decisions.choice: an ox to slaughter: unaware of what is coming
decisions.reason: The ox follows quietly, not knowing where it is being led (Jeremiah 11:19).

source.text: עַ֤ד יְפַלַּ֪ח חֵ֡ץ כְּֽבֵד֗וֹ כְּמַהֵ֣ר צִפּ֣וֹר אֶל־פָּ֑ח וְלֹֽא־יָ֝דַ֗ע כִּֽי־בְנַפְשׁ֥וֹ הֽוּא׃פ

records.literal_gloss: until an arrow pierces his liver, as a bird hurries to a trap, and he does not know that it [is] for his life.

en.L: until an arrow pierces his liver, \q as a bird hurries into a trap, \q and he does not know that it [costs] his life.
en.B: until an arrow splits his liver; \q like a bird rushing into a snare, \q he has no idea it will cost him his life.
en.R: He is like an animal about to be killed by an arrow, or a bird flying into a trap. \q He does not know that it will cost him his life.

fr.L: jusqu’à ce qu’une flèche lui transperce le foie, \q comme un oiseau se précipite dans un piège, \q et il ne sait pas qu’il [y va de] sa vie.
fr.B: jusqu’à ce qu’une flèche lui fende le foie ; \q comme un oiseau qui se jette dans le filet, \q il ne se doute pas que cela lui coûtera la vie.
fr.R: Il est comme un animal qu’une flèche va tuer, ou comme un oiseau qui vole droit dans un piège. \q Il ne sait pas que cela va lui coûter la vie.

sw.L: mpaka mshale uchome ini lake, \q kama ndege aharakishavyo kuingia mtegoni, \q wala hajui kwamba [unagharimu] uhai wake.
sw.B: mpaka mshale upasue ini lake; \q kama ndege anayekimbilia mtegoni, \q hajui hata kidogo kwamba utamgharimu uhai wake.
sw.R: Yeye ni kama mnyama anayekaribia kuuawa kwa mshale, au ndege anayeruka kuingia mtegoni. \q Hajui kwamba jambo hilo litamgharimu maisha yake.

es.L: hasta que una flecha le traspasa el hígado, \q como el ave se apresura a la trampa, \q y no sabe que [le cuesta] la vida.
es.B: hasta que una flecha le parte el hígado; \q como un pájaro que se lanza a la red, \q no tiene idea de que le costará la vida.
es.R: Es como un animal a punto de morir por una flecha, o un pájaro que vuela hacia una trampa. \q No sabe que eso le costará la vida.

decisions.choice: an arrow pierces his liver: a fatal wound
decisions.reason: The liver stands for the inner life (Lamentations 2:11). The arrow is the hunter's, completing the picture of the hunted animal (verse 22).

decisions.choice: his life: his very self
decisions.reason: The word (nephesh) as in 6:26: she hunts a man's life.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִ֑י וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבוּ לְאִמְרֵי־פִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, sons, listen to me, and pay attention to [the] sayings of my mouth.

en.L: And now, sons, listen to me, \q and pay attention to [the] sayings of my mouth.
en.B: So now, sons, listen to me; \q pay close attention to what I say.
en.R: So, sons, listen to me. \q Pay attention to what I say.

fr.L: Et maintenant, fils, écoutez-moi, \q et soyez attentifs aux paroles de ma bouche.
fr.B: Maintenant donc, mes fils, écoutez-moi ; \q soyez bien attentifs à ce que je dis.
fr.R: Alors, mes fils, écoutez-moi. \q Faites attention à ce que je dis.

sw.L: Basi sasa, enyi wana, nisikilizeni, \q na msikilize maneno ya kinywa changu.
sw.B: Basi sasa, wana, nisikilizeni; \q sikilizeni kwa makini ninayosema.
sw.R: Basi, wana, nisikilizeni. \q Sikilizeni kwa makini ninayosema.

es.L: Y ahora, hijos, {{plural_you:escúchenme|escuchadme}}, \q y {{plural_you:estén|estad}} atentos a [los] dichos de mi boca.
es.B: Así que ahora, hijos, {{plural_you:escúchenme|escuchadme}}; \q {{plural_you:presten|prestad}} mucha atención a lo que digo.
es.R: Así que, hijos, {{plural_you:escúchenme|escuchadme}}. \q {{plural_you:Presten|Prestad}} atención a lo que digo.

decisions.choice: sons: the plural address, as in 4:1 and 5:7
decisions.reason: The story is over, and the father draws the lesson for all his sons.

source.text: אַל־יֵ֣שְׂטְ אֶל־דְּרָכֶ֣יהָ לִבֶּ֑ךָ אַל־תֵּ֝תַע בִּנְתִיבוֹתֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let not turn aside to her ways your heart; do not wander in her pathways,

en.L: Let not your heart turn aside to her ways; \q do not wander into her paths,
en.B: Do not let your heart drift toward her ways \q or stray onto her paths,
en.R: Do not even think about going her way. \q Do not go anywhere near her.

fr.L: Que ton cœur ne se détourne pas vers ses chemins ; \q ne t’égare pas dans ses sentiers,
fr.B: Ne laisse pas ton cœur dériver vers ses chemins, \q et ne t’égare pas sur ses sentiers,
fr.R: Ne pense même pas à prendre son chemin. \q Ne va nulle part près d’elle.

sw.L: Moyo wako usigeukie njia zake; \q usitangetange katika mapito yake,
sw.B: Usiache moyo wako uelekee njia zake, \q wala usipotee ukaingia katika mapito yake,
sw.R: Usifikirie hata kidogo kuifuata njia yake. \q Usimkaribie hata kidogo.

es.L: Que no se desvíe tu corazón hacia sus caminos; \q no te extravíes por sus senderos,
es.B: No dejes que tu corazón se vaya tras sus caminos \q ni te pierdas por sus sendas,
es.R: Ni siquiera pienses en irte por su camino. \q No te acerques a ella para nada.

decisions.choice: turn aside: veer off
decisions.reason: The verb (satah) is the one in 4:15, "turn aside from it", and is used of an unfaithful wife (Numbers 5:12).

source.text: כִּֽי־רַבִּ֣ים חֲלָלִ֣ים הִפִּ֑ילָה וַ֝עֲצֻמִ֗ים כָּל־הֲרֻגֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: for many slain she has made fall, and numerous [are] all her killed.

en.L: for many [are the] slain she has made to fall, \q and numerous [are] all her killed.
en.B: for she has brought down many victims, \q and those she has killed are without number.
en.R: She has destroyed many men. \q She has killed more than anyone can count.

fr.L: car nombreux [sont] les blessés à mort qu’elle a fait tomber, \q et nombreux tous ceux qu’elle a tués.
fr.B: car elle a fait tomber bien des victimes, \q et ceux qu’elle a tués sont innombrables.
fr.R: Elle a détruit beaucoup d’hommes. \q Elle en a tué plus qu’on ne peut en compter.

sw.L: kwa maana wengi [ni] waliouawa aliowaangusha, \q na wengi mno [ni] wote aliowaua.
sw.B: kwa maana amewaangusha watu wengi, \q na wale aliowaua hawahesabiki.
sw.R: Amewaangamiza wanaume wengi. \q Amewaua wengi kuliko mtu yeyote awezavyo kuhesabu.

es.L: porque muchos [son los] heridos que ha hecho caer, \q y numerosos [son] todos sus muertos.
es.B: porque ha derribado a muchas víctimas, \q y los que ha matado no tienen número.
es.R: Ella ha destruido a muchos hombres. \q Ha matado a más de los que nadie puede contar.

decisions.choice: numerous: many, or mighty
decisions.reason: The word (atsumim) can mean numerous or strong. Strong men have fallen to her too.

source.text: דַּרְכֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל בֵּיתָ֑הּ יֹ֝רְד֗וֹת אֶל־חַדְרֵי־מָֽוֶת׃פ

records.literal_gloss: [The] ways of Sheol [is] her house, going down to [the] chambers of death.

en.L: Her house [is the] ways to Sheol, \q going down to [the] chambers of death.
en.B: Her house is the highway into Sheol, \q sloping down to the rooms of death.
en.R: Going to her house is like taking the road to the grave. \q It leads straight down to death.

fr.L: Sa maison [est] les chemins du Shéol, \q qui descendent vers les chambres de la mort.
fr.B: Sa maison est la grand-route du séjour des morts, \q qui descend vers les chambres de la mort.
fr.R: Aller chez elle, c’est prendre la route du séjour des morts. \q Cela mène tout droit à la mort.

sw.L: Nyumba yake [ni] njia za Kuzimu, \q zishukazo hadi vyumba vya mauti.
sw.B: Nyumba yake ni barabara kuu iendayo Kuzimu, \q inayoshuka hadi vyumba vya mauti.
sw.R: Kwenda nyumbani kwake ni kama kuchukua barabara iendayo Kuzimu. \q Inashuka moja kwa moja mpaka mautini.

es.L: Su casa [es] camino del Seol, \q que desciende a [las] cámaras de la muerte.
es.B: Su casa es la carretera que lleva al lugar de los muertos, \q que baja hasta las habitaciones de la muerte.
es.R: Ir a su casa es como tomar el camino al lugar de los muertos. \q Lleva directo a la muerte.

decisions.choice: the chambers of death: the inner rooms of the dead
decisions.reason: Her inner rooms (verses 16–17) are, in truth, the rooms of death. The chapter ends as 2:18 and 5:5 do.

decisions.choice: Sheol
decisions.reason: As in 1:12 and 5:5.
